relation.description: A reference to a related place. Producers prefer an ATGeo URN (see origin) where the related place has one, then an AT-URI, then any other URI. Consumers compare uris as exact strings.

uri.description: The related place's identity, e.g. urn:atgeo:overturemaps.org:division:{id}.

name.description: Display name of the related place.

type.description: The related place's type in its dataset's own vocabulary, e.g. an Overture division subtype such as region.
The kind of variant: official, alternate, short, colloquial, historical.

main.description: A geographic place with location, name, and other attributes. A copy keeps its source's origin, or takes the source's at:// URI as origin when the source has none; a place with no origin is its own origin, identified by its at:// URI.

origin.description: What this place describes. For a gazetteer place, an ATGeo URN: urn:atgeo:{dataset}:{collection}:{id}, where the dataset and collection contain no colon and the id is everything after the fourth colon; consumers compare origins as exact strings and may match on a prefix they construct (urn:atgeo:{dataset}:{collection}:); only a gazetteer serving the dataset splits one. For a copy of a repo record that has no origin, that record's at:// URI. Unchanged by copying or editing.

locations.description: The geographic location of the place, in any available representation.

name.description: The primary display name of the place.

variants.description: Alternate names, translations, and other name variants.

attributes.description: Additional attributes of the place, as the dataset defines them.

updatedAt.description: The data provider's stated date for this place's data.

relations.description: Related places, keyed by relation type.

within.description: Places that geographically contain this place, ordered broadest to most specific.

sameAs.description: Other URIs that name the same place.
